messages.author: c7a0d087ca7b2eb2
messages.subject: shiny charset mismatch
parts:
I am running a shiny app from a windows OS.

i can run the [shinyapp][https://yonicd.shinyapps.io/Elections] i made in the RStudio servers that are linux servers.

but when i run the code using

shiny::runGitHub("Elections","yonicd")

it wont run unless the locale is set

Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL","Hebrew_Israel.1255")

making the (windows) user run

#If running on Window Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL","Hebrew_Israel.1255")
shiny::runGitHub("Elections","yonicd")
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL")

which is annoying at best.

the code is in github [global.r][https://github.com/yonicd/Elections/blob/master/global.R] where i load static data from csv files and read data from a dynamic google docs spreadsheet. And rbind them.

if anyone can figure it out then it would be great. ive tried many things but nothing really helps...

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: shiny charset mismatch
parts:
Hi, 
   I can't run your app because you are using a very updated R. 
  But I think the problem is you are using Hebrew character set. And by default your PC is using another one. Check it using: Sys.getlocale()

  I am not sure, but maybe you can include a command line in your Global.R file: 
if (Sys.info()[1] == "Windows")    Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL","Hebrew_Israel.1255") 

Good luck!
